method: Visual inspection of all eight neutral renders against PR58 approved full-body concepts; filenames were not used to assign identity.

source-1.observations: Brown/russet swept hair, blue shirt, tan cargo trousers, field hat and leather backpack. Detailed approachable face, younger/rounder than teenage concept. Missing red neckerchief and rear bedroll; closed fists. Hair reads brown rather than concept orange-red; green eye identity/freckles not certified at game scale.

source-2.observations: Blonde braid, blue scarf, cream shirt, olive trousers, backpack/bedroll. Strong outfit/silhouette correspondence. Thin fingers and fine braid geometry need deformation inspection later. Stylized large eyes/head can read younger than a teen.

artifactReview: All four sides have complete visible surface coverage; no obvious hollow back, missing limb or large texture hole in neutral views. This is visual coverage evidence, not manifold/topology or deformation certification. Hat occlusion at 58 degrees is evaluated separately.
